note: Third-party libraries of the engine. Versions follow from the vcpkg commit pinned in .github/workflows/engine.yml. engine/tools/vuln_check.py reads each version from that vcpkg checkout, resolves the upstream release tag to a commit, and asks the OSV database about that commit on every push. 'expected_version' and 'expected_commit' are filled from the first CI run and enforced from then on; null means not yet recorded.

openssl.used_for: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 of file bytes

nlohmann-json.used_for: JSON of results and of channel messages (messages come from the same user, not from scanned files)
